Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring employers to reimburse employees for work-related expenses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring employers to reimburse employees forwork-related expenses; and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An employer shall reimburse his or her employee for the cost ofany cell phone and cell phone plan if the employer requires theemployee to use a cell phone in the discharge of the employee's duties. (2) If an employer does not reimburse the employee as requiredunder this section, the employee may bring a civil cause of action. Ifthe employee prevails, the court shall award the employee reasonableattorneys' fees and costs incurred to enforce this section. Awardscarry interest at the same rate as civil judgments under RCW 4.56.110.Interest accrues from the date on which the employee incurred thenecessary business expense.
